description: This file defines interfaces, proxy and stub classes, and related mechanisms for COM-like object management and RPC communication within the Thunder namespace. It includes class definitions for UnknownStub, UnknownStubType, UnknownProxy, and template proxy classes, along with method declarations for reference counting, interface querying, and message handling.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Base class for RPC stub handling, providing interface ID, conversion, and message handling.

classes.name: UnknownStubType
classes.description: Template class extending UnknownStub to handle specific interface methods and message dispatching.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing reference counting, interface querying, and message passing for RPC proxies.

classes.name: UnknownProxyType
classes.description: Template class providing interface-specific proxy functionality, including reference management and interface querying.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of methods or handlers.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts incoming data to an IUnknown pointer.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Dispatches method calls based on index.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and handles cleanup.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a specific interface if available.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Performs method invocation via message passing.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes proxy operation, managing reference counts and cleanup.
